title: RF-DETR-N vs YOLOX-L: benchmark on COCO
dek: YOLOX-L leads by 4.0 mAP points at 640 px, but RF-DETR-N at 384 px is faster on edge hardware and most converted runtimes.
author: Vision Analysis

blocks.text: YOLOX-L is the more accurate detector, 55.4 vs 51.4 mAP@50-95 against RF-DETR-N on an RTX 5070 Ti in PyTorch. The resolutions differ: RF-DETR-N runs at 384 px and YOLOX-L at 640 px, each at its author default, so read this as a deployment comparison. YOLOX-L edges the PyTorch speed test, 42.8 vs 39.5 FPS, but RF-DETR-N is faster on ONNX Runtime, TensorRT FP32, Jetson Orin, and Raspberry Pi 5. RF-DETR-N uses far less VRAM, 151 vs 307 MB.

RF-DETR-N (30.47M parameters) and YOLOX-L (54.21M) both ship under Apache-2.0 and evaluate on COCO val2017 at different input sizes: RF-DETR-N at 384 px, YOLOX-L at 640 px, each at the author default. Both have verified rows on desktop GPU, Jetson Orin, and Raspberry Pi 5.

blocks.caption: Accuracy vs parameters on COCO val2017. RF-DETR-N and YOLOX-L highlighted against the full set.

blocks.text: mAP is shown in percent form. YOLOX-L measures 55.4 mAP@50-95 to RF-DETR-N's 51.4, a 4.0 point gap, on nearly double the parameter count. The gap widens on small objects: YOLOX-L leads 39.0 vs 27.7 mAP_small, a 29.09% relative difference.

In PyTorch on the RTX 5070 Ti, YOLOX-L runs 42.8 FPS to RF-DETR-N's 39.5. The order flips under conversion on two of three GPU runtimes: RF-DETR-N reaches 67.6 vs 61.8 FPS on TensorRT FP32 and 65.7 vs 50.6 on ONNX Runtime. YOLOX-L stays ahead on TensorRT FP16, 79.2 vs 58.3.
On edge hardware RF-DETR-N is the faster model. It runs 10.2 FPS to YOLOX-L's 5.8 on Jetson Orin, and 2.1 vs 0.4 on Raspberry Pi 5.

Pick YOLOX-L for desktop deployment where the accuracy and small-object lead justify the larger model. Pick RF-DETR-N for edge and most converted runtimes, where it runs faster at 384 px on less than half the VRAM, 151 vs 307 MB. Both ship under Apache-2.0.

# pip install libreyolo
from libreyolo import LibreYOLO

rfdetr = LibreYOLO("LibreRFDETRn.pt")  # 30.47M params, 51.4 mAP@50-95
yolox = LibreYOLO("LibreYOLOXl.pt")    # 54.21M params, 55.4 mAP@50-95

results = yolox("image.jpg")
